metrics.label: Unit + integration tests
metrics.scope: Release suite with no failures, errors or skips; implementation checks.

metrics.label: Scripted control episodes
metrics.scope: Task-aware scripted policies across released configurations; not model scores.

metrics.label: Independent optimum checks
metrics.scope: Finite model/objective comparisons against an independently represented oracle.

metrics.label: Executed runtime cases
metrics.scope: Fixed-world/fault cases in 27 recorded profiles; coverage, not independent tasks.

metrics.label: Generic Lean theorem roots
metrics.scope: Generic fault accounting and safe-action roots. Python refinement is not proved.

metrics.label: Exploratory assistant pilot
metrics.scope: Shared host; six development episodes. No OS-enforced isolation or frontier score.

benchmark_card.title: Signal Repair
benchmark_card.subtitle: Globally bounded sensor corruption. Evidence before irreversible action.

fields.label: Missing component
fields.body: Fill the selected action and observed exclusion witnesses. One fixed world and one global fault cap govern the episode.

fields.label: Public evidence
fields.body: Published worlds, truthful sensor table, action success sets, costs and a trusted observation history.

fields.label: Actions and budget
fields.body: Each query is available once. Sensing and commitment share the certified operational budget; setup has a separate tool cost.

fields.label: Strict acceptance
fields.body: The action must work in every feasible world. Exclude each unsafe world with at least k+1 distinct observed contradictions.

fields.label: Recorded evidence
fields.body: Scripted controls, independent finite audits, a shared-host assistant pilot and generic Lean guarantees have separate scopes.

fields.label: Known boundaries
fields.body: Finite symbolic models; no proof of Python refinement, physical sensor validity or frontier hardness.
